styleSelection.reason: Portrait sketch of a ginger-and-white tabby cat on a bearded man's shoulder, built with fine sepia ink contours and light, transparent layered washes over reserved paper whites.

families.referenceCue: Ginger-orange tabby cat head, pointed ears, warm burnt-sienna and yellow-ochre brow stripes, pale muzzle, and dark eye rims.
Reserved paper-white chest bib and muzzle meeting soft cool-grey shadow under the dark collar.
Warm yellow-ochre and burnt-sienna tabby coat sweeping down the back and lower flank.
Dark brown-black hair mass with broken outer contour and directional crown strands.
Warm peach-sienna forehead, nose bridge, and cheeks with dark brows and crisp eye rims.
Dark beard, moustache, lower-face stubble texture, and warm neck and collar.
